Job Description:
 Qlik Sense Developer - Data Visualization 
 Airbus Defence and Space is one of the three Divisions of the Airbus Group and Europe’s Number 1 defence and space company. It is the world’s second largest space company and one of the top 10 defence companies globally. Airbus Defence and Space develops and engineers cutting-edge and peerlessly reliable products in the field of defence and space. Its defence and space technologies enable governments and institutions to protect natural resources, societies and individual freedom.
www.airbusdefenceandspace.com
 Interest group : Data Science/Analytics
 Contract type/working time : Permanent/Fulltime
 Work experience : + 5-7 years
We are looking for a Qlik Sense Developer , to become part of the Airbus Defence and Space Romania, Bucharest team. The role mission within the data science and analytics team, part of the Digital business line, is to support internal users in their needs of data visualization.
The Qlik Developer is working within the data visualization team and under supervision of the Application Manager. He/she will collaborate with the data transport team and SAP BI team for the SAP Hana development part.
Airbus Global Business Services (AGBS) unit is contributing to Airbus’ global success and plays a vital role in Airbus transformation journey in standardization, harmonization, digitalization and automation of end-to-end process (e.g. Procure to Pay) of all overhead functions. Our goal is to drive a significant change and take responsibility for the best outcome of the internal customers, all while embracing a spirit of problem-solving and living the Airbus values: Customer focus, integrity, respect, creativity, reliability and teamwork.
 Responsibilities:
Qlik Sense applications development
Data Modelling (Qlik)
SAP Hana Modelling (SAP Hana Studio)
Solution development according to sprint planning
Support on the applications (request and incident management)
Documentation (user guide, development documentation, training video)
 Requirements: 
Qlik Sense development experience is mandatory
SQL syntax knowledge is mandatory
Design implementation and maintenance of data pipelines experience is mandatory
SAP Hana/BW development experience is mandatory
BMC Remedy knowledge is preferred
Data modelling/degree in computer science is preferred
Proactive attitude to anticipate risks and raise concerns in advance
Willingness to travel occasionally
Fluency in English is mandatory
 Competencies
Strong customer orientation
Excellent written/verbal communication and interpersonal skills
Result oriented and organized
Problem solving skills
Flexibility and adaptation to change
Able to deal with ambiguity
Able to work in a multicultural environment / as part of a team
 What do we offer you?
 A great place to develop your career
 Exciting and meaningful projects
 Continuous education and training
 A motivating salary and a comprehensive package of benefits
 Performance related bonus
 This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.
